ActionSeries.description: Series returned by a read-only action (``return_response`` is implied).
ActionSeries.title: ActionSeries

AttributeSeries.description:
Series held in an attribute of the entities of ``roles`` (concatenated in order).

``list_path`` (Phase 4, generic attribute adapter): dotted path from the attribute's
value to the list of points when the attribute is a mapping (``None`` = the attribute
itself is the list). The period length of a point is the template's
``resolution_min``.
AttributeSeries.title: AttributeSeries

BatteryAction.description:
Battery limits for the gate (Phase 4 WP2; reviewed by ``control-safety`` in WP9).

Every field is optional, at least one must be set; a missing field leaves that limit
as it is. Powers are magnitudes in W (battery + = charging, so ``grid_charge_w`` is a
charging power drawn from the grid): ``max_charge_w`` / ``max_discharge_w`` cap the
inverter's own control, ``min_soc_pct`` is the discharge floor (discharge lock when at
or above the current SoC), ``grid_charge_w > 0`` asks for forced charging from the
grid. Until the battery path exists the gate rejects this action
(``safety.battery_not_supported``); nothing is written.
BatteryAction.title: BatteryAction

BatteryConfig.description:
Battery: power (+ = charging), state of charge in percent, limits.

``control`` is ``observe`` only: SunCore reads the battery; adapters that write
set-points come in a later phase.
BatteryConfig.title: BatteryConfig

BatteryModeMeaning.description: What selecting a battery mode option does.
BatteryModeMeaning.title: BatteryModeMeaning

BatteryModel.description:
What the planner knows about the battery.

The planning floor is ``reserve_pct + bms_drift_margin_pct``: the reserve is the user's
backup energy, the drift margin keeps SunCore off the BMS's own cut-off when the SoC
reading sags (the maintainer's BMS drops from 10 % to 6-7 %). SunCore never plans to
discharge below it; ``max_soc_pct`` caps charging (battery care).
BatteryModel.title: BatteryModel

BatterySettings.description:
Configuration section ``battery`` (schema v1).

``adapter_template_id = None`` means *observe only*: SunCore reads the battery through
the ``site`` section and plans with it, but never writes. With an adapter, ``entities``
maps the template's roles; the battery starts in shadow like every device (the mode
lives in the ``operation`` section). ``target_by_time`` uses ``goals.battery_target``
(target SoC and time); reserve and max SoC are part of ``model``.
BatterySettings.title: BatterySettings

BatteryStrategy.description: How the planner uses the battery (plan §1 item 5, answers 2026-10-16).
BatteryStrategy.title: BatteryStrategy

BatteryTemplate.description:
Battery adapter template (Phase 4, ADR-0006/ADR-0012 kind ``battery``).

``roles`` are the readable and writable entities (e.g. ``soc``, ``power``,
``min_soc_number``, ``max_charge_number``, ``max_discharge_number``, ``mode_select``,
``force_charge_switch``); ``controls`` says what each *writable* role expresses. A
role without a control is read only. Writes go through the safety gate only.
BatteryTemplate.title: BatteryTemplate

CalibrationCharge.description:
Periodic full charge for the BMS's SoC calibration (off by default, question 11).

When enabled the planner schedules a charge to ``target_soc_pct`` once every
``interval_days`` into a sunny day (from PV; grid only if the policy allows it).
CalibrationCharge.title: CalibrationCharge

CheckRequest.description: Optional body of the system check: check this unsaved site instead of the stored one.
CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

ConfigHistoryEntryOut.description: A replaced section body that can be restored.
ConfigHistoryEntryOut.title: ConfigHistoryEntryOut

ContinuousControl.description: A number entity in W, A or % of ``nominal_w`` between ``min`` and ``max``.
ContinuousControl.title: ContinuousControl

ControlMessage.description: The control state changed (tick, decision, mode, emergency stop, override, proposal).
ControlMessage.title: ControlMessage

ControlState.description: Everything the control layer exposes after a tick.
ControlState.title: ControlState

Decision.description: The safety gate's verdict on an intent, as stored in the decision log.
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionKind.description: Outcome of the safety gate for one intent.
DecisionKind.title: DecisionKind

DeviceConfig.description:
One configured device (instance of a template).

``max_switches_per_hour`` / hysteresis / ``settle_s`` ``None`` mean "safety/controller
default", never "unlimited" or "none" (ADR-0012 item 6).

Phase 3 additions (all with defaults, old documents stay valid): ``allow_switch_on``
and ``switch_on_hvac_mode`` (climate only: SunCore may switch the unit on through the
HVAC mode; a set-point write while the unit is off also switches it on, see
research/device-integrations.md), ``override_policy``.
DeviceConfig.title: DeviceConfig

DeviceControlState.description: One controlled device as the "Now" view shows it.
DeviceControlState.title: DeviceControlState

DeviceKind.description: Kind of controllable device. Templates use climate, switch and number_load for now.
DeviceKind.title: DeviceKind

DeviceModeRequest.description:
``PUT /api/v1/operation/devices/{id}``: one device's operating mode.

Raising the mode above shadow needs ``identity``, the token the device carried in
``GET /api/v1/control/state`` when the user decided: a device that was re-mapped meanwhile
answers 409 and keeps its mode.
DeviceModeRequest.title: DeviceModeRequest

DeviceState.description:
What a device looks like right now, as read from the entity cache by a driver.

Only the fields that exist for the device are set; ``on`` is ``None`` when the
control entity is unavailable. For a climate device ``on`` is ``hvac_mode != off``
and ``mode`` is the HVAC mode. ``quality`` is the worst quality of the entities read.
DeviceState.title: DeviceState

EmergencyStopOut.description: State of the global emergency stop after the call.
EmergencyStopOut.title: EmergencyStopOut

EnergyPrefsOut.description: Energy dashboard import: suggestions only, never applied by the server.
EnergyPrefsOut.title: EnergyPrefsOut

EntityCandidateOut.description:
An entity offered for a role.

``device_class`` and ``unit`` are empty strings when unknown. ``score`` is 0 and
``criteria`` empty for the unranked Phase 1 list. ``value`` is the raw state in ``unit``
(no conversion, no sign inversion).
EntityCandidateOut.title: EntityCandidateOut

EntityMatcher.description:
Role matcher; every given criterion must match, ``domain`` is mandatory.

``units`` lists acceptable ``unit_of_measurement`` strings (exact, case-sensitive);
``unit_pattern`` is a regular expression matched with ``re.fullmatch`` on the stripped
unit. ``translation_key`` / ``translation_key_pattern`` likewise. Exact and pattern
forms exclude each other.
EntityMatcher.title: EntityMatcher

EntityRef.description: Reference to a HA entity. ``invert_sign`` flips a source with opposite polarity.
EntityRef.title: EntityRef

ExportTier.description: Feed-in price up to ``up_to_kwp`` of installed power (``None`` = no upper bound).
ExportTier.title: ExportTier

FeedInTier.description:
Feed-in remuneration band, data only (no legal advice).

Bands apply to the share of the plant up to ``up_to_kwp`` (cumulative, lower bounds
are the previous band); ``None`` = no upper bound and only allowed on the last band.
FeedInTier.title: FeedInTier

FlowOut.description: A value in W (or % for the state of charge) with its data quality.
FlowOut.title: FlowOut

FlowsOut.description: Site flows in W, core sign convention (grid + = import, battery + = charging).
FlowsOut.title: FlowsOut

ForceChargeSwitchControl.description: A ``switch`` role: on = force charging (from the grid if PV is short), off = auto.
ForceChargeSwitchControl.title: ForceChargeSwitchControl

ForecastConfig.description:
PV forecast sources (schema v2: several sources, blending, learning settings).

Independent of the tariff so that the wizard can store the choice without prices.
Forecast uncertainty is handled by the learned risk model and the battery section's
``risk`` level, not by a flat discount.
ForecastConfig.title: ForecastConfig

ForecastSourceConfig.description:
One PV forecast source: its template, the entities of its roles and its weight.

``weight_mode = auto`` blends by measured skill (inverse MAE, WP5); ``manual`` uses
``weight`` (relative, normalised over all sources by the blender).
ForecastSourceConfig.title: ForecastSourceConfig

GoalsConfig.description:
User goals (schema v2).

v2 drops ``grid_charge_night_only`` (answers 2026-10-16, question 7): grid charging is
allowed by a price level and/or a schedule in the ``battery`` section's
:class:`~suncore.core.battery.GridChargePolicy`. ``grid_charge_schedule`` carries the
window a v1 document implied (``True`` -> 22:00-06:00 daily) so the choice is not
lost; the planner uses it as the policy's schedule when the policy has none. **It never
enables grid charging**: that stays off until the user enables the policy with a level
or a schedule. ``conservative_planning`` = targets are planned on P10 PV (default on).
GoalsConfig.title: GoalsConfig

GridChargePolicy.description:
When the battery may be charged from the grid (answers 2026-10-16, question 7).

Off by default. When enabled, a ``max_price`` (charge only at or below this import
price) and/or a ``schedule`` (only inside these weekly windows) must be set; both given
means both must hold. On a dynamic tariff the planner's spread rule
(:meth:`BatteryModel.grid_charge_pays`) applies in addition.
GridChargePolicy.title: GridChargePolicy

GridConfig.description: Grid connection: one signed sensor (+ = import) OR an import/export pair, plus limits.
GridConfig.title: GridConfig

GridFeeWindow.description: A grid fee that applies inside ``window`` (time-variable grid fee, §14a module 3).
GridFeeWindow.title: GridFeeWindow

ImportTariff.description:
How the price of imported energy is obtained.

* ``fixed``: one ``fixed_price``.
* ``dynamic``: a price source (``template_id`` and/or ``price_entity``); ``formula``
  turns a spot-only price into the end price (tariff v3; ``None`` = the source's price
  is used as it is, e.g. Tibber's all-in price).
* ``tou``: fixed time-of-use prices (HT/NT, seasonal) in ``tou`` (tariff v3).
ImportTariff.title: ImportTariff

Intent.description: What a control layer wants to do to one asset, and why.
Intent.title: Intent

LearningSettings.description:
What SunCore may learn from history (forecast calibration, load model).

Kept in the ``forecast`` section because it governs how forecasts are produced. Before
``min_history_days`` of history exist, calibration and the ML load model only collect
statistics and change nothing. ``load_ml_mode``: ``off``; ``shadow`` (default) = the
optional ML load model runs in parallel and is only scored and shown for comparison;
``auto`` = it is used when it beats the profile forecast in the accuracy statistics -
it never replaces the profiles otherwise.
LearningSettings.title: LearningSettings

Mode.description: One mode of a mode-controlled device and the power it draws.
Mode.title: Mode

ModeAction.description: Select a mode value (select option, climate HVAC mode or preset).
ModeAction.title: ModeAction

ModeControl.description: Select one of several modes (select entity or climate preset).
ModeControl.title: ModeControl

ModeSelectControl.description: A ``select`` role choosing the battery's operating mode.
ModeSelectControl.title: ModeSelectControl

NegativePriceRule.description: Feed-in remuneration during negative spot prices.
NegativePriceRule.title: NegativePriceRule

NumberLimitControl.description:
A ``number`` role that sets a battery limit.

``min_soc``: discharge floor in ``%`` (discharge lock / reserve); ``max_charge`` and
``max_discharge``: power limits; ``grid_charge_power``: forced charging power from the
grid. ``min``/``max``/``step`` are the entity's range in ``unit`` (``%`` of the
battery's maximum power for the power kinds).
NumberLimitControl.title: NumberLimitControl

OperatingMode.description: Operating mode per device and globally (BRIEF §4.11).
OperatingMode.title: OperatingMode

OperationConfig.description:
Stored operating modes. Not read by the safety gate before Phase 3.

Devices that are new at ``devices`` put/import time lose any entry here (shadow).
OperationConfig.title: OperationConfig

Origin.description: The layer that produced an intent (ADR-0011).
Origin.title: Origin

OverrideCommand.title: OverrideCommand

OverridePolicy.title: OverridePolicy

PowerEstimate.description:
A device's power with its uncertainty (BRIEF §4.5: both power paths are equivalent).

``value_w ± uncertainty_w`` is the band the controller and the grid invariant work
with; ``quality`` is the worst quality of the inputs; ``age_s`` is the age of the
newest input that produced the estimate.
PowerEstimate.title: PowerEstimate

PowerModel.description:
Power source of a device; refers to roles of :attr:`DeviceConfig.entities`.

* ``measured``: needs ``power_role`` (a power sensor).
* ``counter_derived``: needs ``energy_role``; the average power is derived from counter
  deltas (latency and quantisation apply, ``counter_update_s`` is the latency floor).
* ``learned``: needs ``nominal_w`` as prior; ``power_role``/``energy_role`` train it.
* ``nominal``: needs ``nominal_w``.

The unit of the counter is read from the live state (like ``core/balance.py``); a
non-energy unit yields quality ``invalid`` at runtime.
PowerModel.title: PowerModel

PowerModelDefault.description:
Default power model; ``power_role``/``energy_role`` refer to roles of the template.

``nominal_w`` is only a hint: a template cannot know the user's model, the wizard asks
(the instance-level :class:`~suncore.core.devices.PowerModel` stays strict).
PowerModelDefault.title: PowerModelDefault

PowerModelKind.description: How a device's power is obtained (BRIEF §4.5); each kind yields an uncertain estimate.
PowerModelKind.title: PowerModelKind

PowerSetpointAction.description: Request a power set-point in W (device + = consumption, battery + = charging).
PowerSetpointAction.title: PowerSetpointAction

PriceFormula.description:
Spot price -> end price (BRIEF §4.4).

``end = (spot * spot_multiplier + grid_fee(at) + levies + margin) * (1 + vat_pct/100)``

``grid_fee(at)`` is the fee of the first ``grid_fee_windows`` entry containing ``at``,
else ``grid_fee``. VAT is applied to the whole sum, as on a German bill; a negative
spot price can make the end price negative. Only for ``price_includes = spot_only``
sources - an all-in price never gets the formula on top.
PriceFormula.title: PriceFormula

PvArray.description: One PV array (roof plane / inverter input). Everything but ``name`` is optional.
PvArray.title: PvArray

Quality.description: Data quality, ordered best to worst: ok < stale < unavailable < invalid.
Quality.title: Quality

Reason.description:
A structured, translatable explanation.

``key`` addresses a message in the ICU catalogue; ``args`` are the
placeholders of that message. Free text is not allowed anywhere.
Reason.title: Reason

RegionConfig.description: Region template choice, currency, time zone and UI language.
RegionConfig.title: RegionConfig

RelayStep.description: One level of a relay-switched load: the relays that are on and the power it draws.
RelayStep.title: RelayStep

RelaysControl.description:
Discrete power levels made of 1-3 switch entities (e.g. a heater with three elements).

``roles`` are the relay switches; step ``i`` means exactly the relays listed in
``steps[i].relays`` are on and the others are off. Step 0 is the lowest level
(normally all off). Added to schema v1 as an additive union member (ADR-0012).
RelaysControl.title: RelaysControl

ReleaseAction.description: Give the device back: restore the takeover baseline and stop controlling it.
ReleaseAction.title: ReleaseAction

RiskLevel.description:
How sure the plan must be that a battery target is met (forecast/buffer concept).

The planner plans the target on a quantile of the net energy forecast (PV minus load):
``cautious`` meets it with probability 0.9 (10 % quantile), ``balanced`` 0.75 (25 %),
``bold`` 0.5 (median).
RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel

RoleSpec.description: One entity role of a template.
RoleSpec.title: RoleSpec

SeriesFields.description: Names of the fields of one series point and the unit of its values.
SeriesFields.title: SeriesFields

SetpointAction.description:
Write an absolute temperature set-point in °C.

``base_c`` is the user's own set-point the controller shifts from; it is recorded so
the decision log and the release path know what "back to normal" means. A shift of
zero (``setpoint_c == base_c``) restores the user's value.
SetpointAction.title: SetpointAction

SetpointControl.description: Shift the user's temperature set-point inside the comfort band (needs ``comfort``).
SetpointControl.title: SetpointControl

SiteConfig.description: Site description. Entity ids come from the user; none are hard-coded.
SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig

SiteControlState.description: The smoothed site view of the latest tick (W; grid + = import).
SiteControlState.title: SiteControlState

SourceRef.description: Documentation a template (or one of its facts) is based on.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

Step.description: One level of a stepped load: the value written and the power it draws.
Step.title: Step

StepAction.description: Select step ``step`` (index into the device's ``control.steps``; 0 = lowest).
StepAction.title: StepAction

StepsControl.description: Discrete power levels written to ``role`` (select option or number).
StepsControl.title: StepsControl

SwitchAction.description:
Turn a device on or off.

For a climate device "on" means the configured ``switch_on_hvac_mode`` and "off"
means HVAC mode ``off``; a switch-on needs the device's ``allow_switch_on`` opt-in
(checked by the safety invariants).
SwitchAction.title: SwitchAction

TariffConfig.description:
Import and export prices (the forecast sources live in :class:`ForecastConfig`).

v3 (Phase 4): ``import.formula`` and kind ``tou``; v2 documents are valid v3 bodies.
TariffConfig.title: TariffConfig

TemplateErrorOut.description: A user template that failed to load. ``message`` is technical English.
TemplateErrorOut.title: TemplateErrorOut

TestedWith.description: Integration version the template was verified against.
TestedWith.title: TestedWith

TimeWindow.description:
Local-time window on given weekdays (0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday).

``start`` > ``end`` wraps over midnight (e.g. 22:00-06:00). ``start == end`` is rejected.
TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

TouPeriod.description: A price that applies inside ``window``, optionally only in some ``months``.
TouPeriod.title: TouPeriod

TouTariff.description:
Fixed time-of-use import tariff (HT/NT, seasonal).

The first period in list order that applies wins; outside every period ``base_price``
applies. Overlaps are therefore allowed and resolved by order (put the special case
first).
TouTariff.title: TouTariff

TouWindow.description:
A local time window on a set of weekdays, e.g. NT Mon-Fri 22:00-06:00.

* ``end`` before ``start`` crosses midnight; the part after midnight belongs to the
  weekday the window *started* on (Fri 22:00-06:00 covers Saturday 00:00-06:00, not
  Friday 00:00-06:00).
* ``start == end`` is the whole day (00:00-00:00 = 24 h).
* ``start`` is included, ``end`` is excluded.
TouWindow.title: TouWindow

ValidationErrorOut.description: 422 body of a request that failed validation.
ValidationErrorOut.title: ValidationErrorOut

ValidationIssueOut.description: One invalid field. ``key`` is a catalogue key, ``args`` its ICU placeholders.
ValidationIssueOut.title: ValidationIssueOut

WeeklySchedule.description: Union of weekly windows (grid-charge schedule, HT/NT windows, §14a module 3).
WeeklySchedule.title: WeeklySchedule

info.description: SunCore HTTP API. Live updates: WebSocket `api/v1/live` (see LiveMessage).
info.title: SunCore API

schema.title: Response Export Config Api V1 Config Export Get

409.description: The document would raise a mode

get.description: Replaced bodies of a section, newest first (the last 20).

schema.title: Response History Api V1 Config  Section  History Get

post.description: Make a history entry current again (the current body moves to the history).

409.description: The stored body no longer validates

post.description: Release every device (baseline restored) and refuse all writes until cleared.
Allow control again; the operating modes are unchanged.

get.description:
Per device: observed state, power estimate with uncertainty, effective mode, hold and
release state, the controller's reasons and the newest gate decision; for the site the
smoothed total and free surplus and the deficit; the open proposals.

The decision log, newest first. ``device_id`` keeps one device's decisions, ``kind``
(repeatable) the given kinds (``shadow``, ``accepted``, ``proposed``, ...).

schema.title: Response Decisions Api V1 Decisions Get

post.description: Boost (N minutes), pause (until a time or until resumed) or resume one device.

get.description:
Entities for a site role (``role``) or a template role (``template`` + ``role``).

Without parameters: the unranked power and battery sensors of the Phase 1 picker.
``include_hidden`` also lists hidden, diagnostic and config entities (ranked lower);
disabled entities never appear. ``device_name`` (template roles) ranks candidates of a
device with that name first. Served from the registry snapshot and state cache,
never per-request from HA.

schema.title: Response Entities Api V1 Entities Get

put.description:
Set one device's mode. Anything above shadow needs the device's ``identity`` token
from the control state; shadow never does.

409.description: The device changed since its identity was read

put.description:
Set the global operating mode. A device runs in ``min(global, device)``; lowering to
shadow releases the controlled devices (after their minimum run or pause time).

post.description: Live values of every entity in an unsaved SiteConfig or DeviceConfig fragment.

get.description: Open assisted-mode proposals, oldest first (valid until ``expires_at``).

schema.title: Response Proposals Api V1 Proposals Get

post.description:
Confirm: the proposal is submitted as the user's intent; the answer is the gate's
decision (``accepted``, ``rejected`` by an invariant, ``failed`` ...).

get.description: Template gallery; ``errors`` lists user templates that failed to load.

post.description: System check of the stored site (or of ``site`` in the body) against live values.

get.description: Suggestions from the Energy dashboard; ``configured: false`` if it was never saved.
